label: Updated at 8 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Corning Classic Returns
items.text: The Corning Classic returns to the LPGA schedule after an 18-year absence, offering a $5 million purse among the richest outside the majors.

items.headline: Rahm's Future Uncertain
items.text: Jon Rahm faces warnings regarding his future on the PGA Tour amid ongoing questions about LIV Golf's long-term direction.

items.headline: Aspiring Pro's Injury Setback
items.text: James Nicholas suffered bone bruises in both heels from a high-jump injury, forcing him to crawl for seven days and delaying his PGA Tour aspirations.
